# Efter kritiken mot Asker – Förvaltaren: ”Tyvärr ganska vanligt”

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-09-15  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Börslunch (EFN) from 15 September 2026, recorded just after the Swedish election. The Stockholm exchange was down 0.8%. The guests were Johan Agerman (Brock Milton) and Jonas Skilje (Prio 9 / Nilsson Fonder). Main themes were political risk in care and school stocks, AI 'basket' trading hurting Sinch and Addnode, and Carnegie's criticism of Asker's adjusted earnings. The guests said to start from cash flow and trust management's capital allocation when judging serial acquirers, and they favoured Sdiptech and OEM. Data-centre build-out beneficiaries such as Bravida and AQ Group also came up. Guests saw value in beaten-down names, while the macro backdrop was cautious: oil near $110 and the US 10-year yield above 5%.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ACAD — Academedia | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest (Nilsson Fonder) owns it; very low valuation, political risk more than priced in, limited downside.

#### Reasoning

The guest is one of the few institutional managers holding Academedia. They argue the valuation is so low that all political risk after the election is more than priced in, so downside is limited. A re-rating would need a new view of the case. Political statements will cause short-term volatility.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new political restrictions on profits in schools are enacted
- if the case is re-rated downward on fundamentals

> *"vi tycker att det är ett bolag som är så otroligt lågt värderat att i princip all politisk risk är mer än väl inprisad i kursen"*

---

### 🟢 SINCH — Sinch | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest holds it; wrongly placed in the AI-loser basket; Voice AI needs CPaaS; US peers strong; very cheap.

#### Reasoning

The guest argues Sinch is not clearly an AI loser, because Voice AI deployments typically run through CPaaS providers. US peers have performed strongly while Sinch lags. Slower North American growth than Twilio may explain part of the gap, but the valuation is described as very cheap.

#### Sell Triggers

- if North American growth keeps lagging peers
- if AI actually erodes messaging volumes

> *"Men den är ju väldigt, den är väldigt billig."*

---

### ⛔ ASKER — Asker | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Carnegie flagged aggressive cost adjustments; gap between profit and cash flow; high leverage; weak organic growth; guest won't call it a buy yet.

#### Reasoning

The guests echo Carnegie's (cited analyst) criticism: large adjustments embellish earnings, and it is newly listed with a PE background. Leverage is high, which the guests call catastrophic for a serial acquirer, and organic growth is weak, so acquisitions are required. It could become a buying opportunity at some point, but a guest said they know it too poorly. The CEO bought 20k shares after selling higher.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cash conversion improves and adjustments shrink
- if leverage is reduced

> *"Nu har de dessutom en hög leverage, vilket är katastrofalt för en serieförvärvare."*

---

### 🟢 SDIP-B — Sdiptech | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Large guest holding; restructured under new management, about 20% margin, refinanced, expensive preference shares removed, organic growth accelerating, acquisitions resuming.

#### Reasoning

The guest owns Sdiptech as a large holding. After over-acquiring in 2021-22 (net debt/EBITDA above 4), a new CEO brought disciplined capital allocation and divested non-core units. At year-end it could be bought at 11-12x underlying cash flow. The core niche industrial businesses have about 20% operating margin, strong cash flows and electrification-safety exposure. Debt is refinanced, preference shares removed, and acquisitions are returning alongside accelerating organic growth.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it returns to aggressive high-multiple acquisitions
- if organic growth stalls
- if leverage rises again

> *"Du äger Sdiptech som är ett av dina större innehav."*

---

### 🟢 OEM-B — OEM International | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest holds it; buys at about 5x earnings with high returns on invested capital; net cash; new EQT-led board accelerating acquisitions.

#### Reasoning

The guest (Jonas) holds it and calls OEM one of the best acquirers: low acquisition multiples, about 20% returns on invested capital, and it keeps acquired companies profitable. It sat on net cash, but under EQT ownership has made more acquisitions this year than in the prior three. The risk is high expectations on the pace of putting the balance sheet to work.

#### Sell Triggers

- if acquisition pace disappoints versus expectations
- if acquisition multiples rise

> *"Jag tycker att OEM International som vi har i portföljen är väldigt duktiga."*

---

### 🟢 ANOD-B — Addnode | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Down 3.6% in a negative trend; guest thinks it is a bit too cheap and AI risks in software are overstated.

#### Reasoning

Addnode sits in the AI-loser basket. The guest believes AI risks are exaggerated for many software companies. Addnode resells Autodesk and Dassault tools used for engineering, which are hard to replace with vibe-coded tools. The host framed it as 'buy a little cautiously', and the guest agreed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI tools actually displace CAD/PLM resale
- if the negative trend persists with weak reports

> *"Jo, men vi tror att den är nog lite för billig här."*

---

### 🟢 REY — Reply | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest's favourite; project-based IT consultancy helping clients implement AI; guest has added to consultants this year.

#### Reasoning

The global manager has added to consultants during the year. Reply is a skilled, project-based IT consultancy that should benefit from clients needing help implementing AI.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI reduces demand for consulting projects

> *"Italienska Reply är en favorit? Ja, men det är en duktig it-konsult"*

---

### 🟠 BRAV — Bravida | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Won large data-centre projects across the Nordics; 20-25% of order book is data centres; pipeline strong.

#### Reasoning

The guest says Bravida has proven itself as a data-centre installer across Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland, with 20-25% of the order book tied to data centres. The industry reports a large data-centre pipeline, though not yet firm orders. The stock has already performed well.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-centre pipeline fails to convert into orders

> *"uppenbarligen positionerar sig Bravida väldigt bra här som en leverantör av datacenter"*

---

### 🟢 AQ — AQ Group | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest's data-centre winner pick: about 10% of sales direct to data centres plus about 30% electrification exposure.

#### Reasoning

Asked to name one data-centre build-out winner, the guest chose AQ Group. Close to 10% of revenue goes directly to data centres, and about 30% of the group is electrification, which benefits indirectly from grid expansion.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-centre build-out in the Nordics slows

> *"ta ett AQ Group till exempel som har 10 % snart av sin omsättning mot datacenter direkt"*

---

### 🟠 NYAB — Nyab | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Has won a data-centre project but has more to prove.

#### Reasoning

The guest said Nyab has taken some data-centre work but still needs to prove itself in the segment compared with Bravida.

#### Sell Triggers

- if no further data-centre orders materialise

> *"Nya har tagit något projekt inom datacenter. Så det är väl lite mer att bevisa där."*

---
